choose.when: (p.scope_type='GROUP' AND p.scope_id=#{id} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_plan_chapter pc WHERE pc.plan_id=p.id AND pc.group_id=#{id}))
(p.scope_type='CHAPTER' AND p.scope_id=#{id} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_study_plan_chapter pc WHERE pc.plan_id=p.id AND pc.chapter_id=#{id}))

mapper.update: UPDATE sr_study_plan p SET p.status='CANCELLED' WHERE p.status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','PAUSED') AND
UPDATE sr_study_task t JOIN sr_study_plan p ON p.id=t.plan_id SET t.status='SKIPPED' WHERE p.status='CANCELLED' AND t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','TODO','OVERDUE') AND
mapper.delete: DELETE r FROM sr_tutorial_question_card r LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial_question q ON q.id=r.question_id LEFT JOIN sr_tutorial_knowledge_card c ON c.id=r.knowledge_card_id WHERE q.chapter_id=#{chapterId} OR c.chapter_id=#{chapterId}
